svg.title: Timing requirements depend on complete waveforms and phase weights
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Timing requirements depend on complete waveforms and phase weights
Raw slope error at 100 fs RMS: not an in-band phase result
2 ms differential phase; total per-channel jitter remains 100 fs
80 fs shared + 60 fs private: identical 0.000134848°; opposite 0.000287803°.
Static aperture advance: +50 ps → +0.36° at 20 MHz; 0.02° needs ≤2.77778 ps.
Independent sample timing errors are an assumed model; colored / periodic jitter needs new weights.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
